item.title: Fed holds interest rates steady even as inflation remains stubborn
item.description: The Federal Reserve opted to leave its benchmark interest rate unchanged — but investors widely expect the central bank to raise rates at its next meeting in December to combat stubborn inflation.
item.content:encoded:
The Federal Reserve opted to leave its benchmark interest rate unchanged — but investors widely expect the central bank to raise rates at its next meeting in December to combat stubborn inflation.

(Image credit: Andrew Harnik)
item.dc:creator: Scott Horsley

item.title: Fed expected to hold interest rates steady but a hike is anticipated by year's end
item.description: The Federal Reserve is expected to hold its benchmark interest rate steady Wednesday. But investors think a rate hike in December is likely, as the central bank tries to tamp down inflation.

item.title: AI panic and market volatility: Are the stock market's big gains unsustainable?
item.description: Stock markets are being hit by intense periods of volatility that are raising concerns about whether the big gains seen over the past four years can be sustained. Fears about AI are a big reason.

item.title: Why Meta is charging to post more hyperlinks
item.description: Social media sites aren't the biggest fans of people leaving via hyperlinks. In fact, Meta has made it subscription-worthy for a Facebook Page to post more than two hyperlinks per month. What's the rationale for companies want to keep you on their site?

item.title: Gene editing scientists slowed down for safety. Could AI leaders follow their guide?
item.description: Some of the leaders of the AI race are calling for a slowdown, for safety's sake. Viewed in economics terms, it's a collective action problem: no one wants to slow down unless everyone does.
